## How to Customize The Different Elements of SEO Templates


Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000076758


## Overview


Sites launch with default SEO templates that can be customized. The following elements are editable within an SEO template:

- H1

- H2

- Meta Title

- Meta Description

- Meta Keywords

- Social Media


## Accessing an SEO Template


- Navigate to My Content > SEO Templates .

- Hover over Actions , then click Customize . If the template has already been customized, it can instead be located and opened by clicking Edit.


## About Each Element



### H1


The main heading element of a page.


### H2


A secondary heading element of a page.


### Page Content


Used to add additional content to the body of the page.

CAUTION: This option is only available for SEO templates #500 and #501. To add custom content to other search results pages, the recommended approach is converting them into static pages first. Further detail is available in the " Adding SEO Content to a Specific Member Search Results Page — Turn Dynamic Pages into Static Pages " and " How to Turn Posts and Post Categories Search Results Pages into Static Pages " articles.


### SEO Settings


Used to edit SEO meta tags and Social Media Sharing details, and to add custom CSS to the specific template. Further detail is available in the " How To Edit The SEO Settings Of Dynamic (Search Results) Pages " article.


### Advanced Settings


Used to edit the SEO Page-Level CSS Styles, Page-Level HEAD Tags, and Page-Level Footer JavaScript.


### Page Details


Displays the information of the specific template.


### Page Options


Used to adjust display settings, such as hiding the header, footer, or banner ads, enable or disable advanced options, and add or edit breadcrumbs on Search Results SEO templates.


## Disabling or Deleting a Custom Template


- Locate the custom template.

- Hover over Actions .

- Click Disable or Delete to revert to the default template.
